violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored So Do Not Hold Water (26 TAC §747.4813(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored So Do Not Hold Water
violation_type.typical_finding: During a walk through of the play ground, a pool and fire pit were both observed with a body of standing water.     This was corrected during the inspection when the provider dumped the water from the fire pit and the pool thrown away.
